I fixed the pipeline in the three writable files. No tests were run (no executor available); changes were verified by reading the code against the spec.

**`src/merge.mjs`** — rewritten:
- No longer mutates `DEFAULTS` (the old `Object.assign(defaults, ...)` was the cross-call leak and the source of retained references).
- Builds a fresh result object with fresh `network`/`ui` objects, copying only the documented keys (`endpoint`, `retries`, `theme`, `compact`, `enabled`), so unknown fields are dropped and nested siblings are preserved.
- Merges `network` and `ui` field-by-field across defaults < file < env, so a partial override keeps siblings.
- Uses `!== undefined` checks so `false`/`0` survive; `enabled` resolves env → file → default.

**`src/env-config.mjs`** — rewritten:
- Presence checks use `!== undefined` instead of truthiness, so `APP_RETRIES=0`/`"00"` and `APP_ENABLED=false` are honored.
- `APP_RETRIES` must match `/^[0-9]+$/` (leading zeros allowed) and parse to a safe integer ≤ `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, else `TypeError`.
- `APP_COMPACT`/`APP_ENABLED` must be exactly `"true"`/`"false"`, else `TypeError`.
- Missing keys have no effect; other keys ignored; invalid layer objects still throw `TypeError`.

**`src/validate.mjs`** — tightened:
- `retries` now requires `Number.isSafeInteger` and `<= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` (was `Number.isInteger`).
- Returns a fresh, normalized object (new `network`/`ui` objects) so no input references are retained.

`src/index.mjs`, `src/defaults.mjs`, `src/file-config.mjs`, `src/format.mjs`, `src/legacy.mjs`, and the utilities were left unchanged, so the exported API and `formatLegacy`/`formatConfig` output are preserved.
